## Detailed Projects Directory
1. Geleya (Live: https://geleya.pages.dev | Repo: https://github.com/kishan-ict/Geleya)
   - Category: AI Companion & Multimodal Interaction
   - Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Gemini API, Web Audio API
   - Summary: An empathetic AI companion offering emotional support and intelligent conversational interaction.

2. EARTHVERSE (Live: https://kishan-ict.github.io/EARTHVERSE/ | Repo: https://github.com/kishan-ict/EARTHVERSE)
   - Category: 3D Planetary Simulation & Interactive WebGL
   - Stack: React, Three.js, WebGL, Tailwind CSS, GLSL Shaders
   - Summary: Interactive 3D universe visualizer enabling users to explore celestial physics and geospatial data.

3. CampusTrace (Live: https://campustrace.pages.dev | Repo: https://github.com/kishan-ict/campustrace)
   - Category: Campus Management & Transit Utility
   - Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Leaflet, PostgreSQL
   - Summary: Centralized campus platform with live transit bus tracking and student asset recovery.

4. LLM Council (Repo: https://github.com/kishan-ict/llm-council)
   - Category: Multi-Agent Consensus Engine
   - Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, OpenAI API, Anthropic API, Gemini API
   - Summary: Orchestrates parallel reasoning across top LLMs to eliminate hallucinations and synthesize consensus decisions.
